description.value: Q Pizza is a long-standing local pizza shop on West Saanich Road in Victoria with over two decades of community history. The menu is extensive — spanning gourmet and classic pizzas, pasta, wings, donairs, samosas, and more — with daily house-made dough available in standard, whole-grain, or vegan gluten-free versions. A second Duncan location also operates under the same brand.

address.value: 4517 West Saanich Road, Victoria, BC V8Z 3G3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates OSM phone (+1 250 727 0476), address (4517 W Saanich Rd, V8Z 3G3), and website URL. The site explicitly offers local pickup alongside delivery, and mentions vegan-friendly gluten-free dough options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most other cycling amenities anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: Website uses both 'Q Pizza' and 'QPizza' interchangeably; OSM name 'Q Pizza' is used as listed.
Multiple locations exist (Victoria and Duncan); OSM record appears to refer specifically to the 4517 West Saanich Rd Victoria location based on address confirmation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active pizza restaurant with a functioning website and confirmed address. Useful to touring cyclists as a meal and pickup stop with extended daily hours.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states every pizza can be made with 'vegan friendly gluten-free dough' or 100% whole-grain crust; toppings include vegetarian-friendly options such as spinach, feta, and jalapeños
